title: Master of Cataclysms
problem: The 10% sweep has no side filter: enemies' Wrath traits roll too.
notes: Fix: H: add side test 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: All-Cataclysm party with Master of Cataclysms vs an enemy that has a Wrath trait (2100-2110): the enemy's Wrath trait should never get the extra 10% activation at your turn starts. PARTIAL: enemies' Wrath traits no longer roll. Still open: 'at the start of each creature's turn' — the sweep runs only when a creature of the master's side starts its turn; doing it on every creature's turn needs a per-side 'master + all-Cataclysm party' check at the L748-L749 gate (both sides). Round-2 C2 2026-10-26: remainder built as patch SU-0028-turns (needs SU-0028 on): the L748-L749 gate now runs the sweep on every creature's turn when some side holds Master of Cataclysms with an all-Cataclysm party, and the sweep's holder filter (batch-E slot 0x149ed8478, refilled by SU-0028-turns) lets a Wrath trait roll only when its holder's side qualifies. In-game test: all-Cataclysm party + Master of Cataclysms: your Wrath traits also proc (~10%) at the start of ENEMY turns; an enemy Wrath holder without its own qualifying party never procs.

release_notes.intended: If all your creatures are Cataclysms, their traits have a 10% chance to activate at the start of each creature's turn.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, enemies' traits were rolled as well, and the roll only happened on the qualifying side's own turns.
release_notes.fix: Now only the qualifying side's traits roll, at the start of every creature's turn. The every-turn part is a separate switch (SU-0028-turns) that requires SU-0028.
